title: Apple CarPlay Activation
smallDescription: Enable Apple CarPlay on supported BMW head units.
description: Unlock Apple CarPlay functionality. Enjoy navigation, music, messages and more directly from your iPhone on the iDrive screen.

title: Video In Motion
smallDescription: Allow video playback while driving (for passengers).
description: Enable video playback in motion. Observe local laws and drive safely.

title: Full-Screen CarPlay
smallDescription: Use the full display area for Apple CarPlay.
description: Optimizes the display area for Apple CarPlay to occupy more screen real estate where supported.

title: Enhanced Bluetooth
smallDescription: Unlock additional Bluetooth features and profiles.
description: Adds support for additional Bluetooth profiles enabling extra features like album art and extended phonebook integration.

title: Adaptive Headlight Coding
smallDescription: Configure adaptive headlights for your region.
description: Adjusts headlight behavior and pattern for specific regions or preferences.

title: Sport Display Unlock
smallDescription: Enable hidden sport gauges in iDrive.
description: Activates sport display gauges for power/torque on compatible models.
